objective: Build the lifecycle UI on POSTS-004 and USERS-003: a post menu (Copy link, Report, and the owner's Delete), the 'Post deleted' placeholders, deactivating an account from the own-profile settings, and a recovery screen and banner for a deactivated account that otherwise browses as a guest.
acceptance_criteria: Every post card (feed, search, profile, thread root and replies, a quote's own card) has one 'More options' menu button (aria-haspopup, aria-expanded) opening a menu built on the Popover API and native elements, no new dependency: arrow keys move between items, Escape closes the menu only (never the thread modal around it) and returns focus to its button, and Tab leaves it.

Copy link writes the post's absolute address (origin + /posts/<id>) with navigator.clipboard.writeText and announces 'Link copied' in a polite status; a refused or missing clipboard shows the address in a read-only, pre-selected text field instead, never a silent failure.

Report is offered to a signed-in active viewer on another member's post, never on their own and never to a guest or a deactivated account. It opens a confirm (role alertdialog, 'Report this post?' with Report and Cancel, focus on Cancel); confirming sends POST /posts/<id>/report once, and after its 204 the item reads 'Reported' and is disabled for the rest of the session (a reload offers it again). A failure is an inline alert in the confirm, which stays open.

Delete is offered only on the viewer's own post (post.author.id equals the GET /users/me id) and never on a plain repost (whose removal stays the Undo repost toggle). It opens a confirm ('Delete this post?', Delete and Cancel, focus on Cancel); confirming sends DELETE /posts/<id>. On 204 the card is removed at once from every cached feed, search and profile page that holds it (setQueryData), then those queries and the open thread are invalidated; a 403, 404 or 409 is an inline alert naming what happened, and the card stays.

A confirm opened inside the thread modal is a nested alertdialog over it: Escape or Cancel closes only the confirm and returns focus to the menu button; the modal flow's depth, Back and Close are unchanged.

Deleting the root of the open thread leaves the modal open on POSTS-004's 'Post deleted' card with the surviving replies under it; deleting a reply removes it from the thread's list and refetches the parent's counts.

A plain repost whose original is gone (reposted_post null, reposted_post_deleted true) and a quote repost whose original is gone both render a 'Post deleted' placeholder in the original's place: no author, text, media, preview or link, a muted card with the text 'Post deleted'; the reposter's own line and controls are unchanged. A reply whose parent is gone needs no change (POSTS-004 keeps the thread readable).

Own-profile settings gain an 'Account' section at the end with a 'Deactivate account' button (destructive styling). It opens a confirm explaining that posts are hidden until recovery and that individually deleted posts stay deleted; confirming sends DELETE /users/me. On 204 the react-query cache is cleared except the session, GET /users/me is read again, and the app shows the deactivated state below.

auth/profile.ts reports GET /users/me's 403 {"detail": "account_deactivated"} as its own result (not an error and not 'no profile'), through the one PROFILE_QUERY_KEY entry; any other 403 is still an error.

A signed-in deactivated account browses public pages as a guest: like, reply, repost, follow, compose, the post menu's Report and Delete, and FRONTEND-017's Post about this links are absent or behave exactly as for a guest, and every page shows a persistent banner (role region, named) 'Your account is deactivated' with a Recover account button and Sign out.

Any RequireAuth route (compose, notifications) shows a recovery screen instead of its content for a deactivated account: a heading, what recovery does (restores the account and its posts, not individually deleted ones), Recover account and Sign out. RequireNewProfile never offers profile creation to a deactivated account.

Recover account sends POST /users/me/recover; on 200 every cached query is invalidated, the banner and recovery screen go, and the route the viewer was on renders as an active member. A failure is an inline alert beside the button.

One hook decides the account state for the whole app (loading, anonymous, active, deactivated) from useAuth and the one profile query; PostNode, the stats pages' links and the guards read it, nobody re-derives it.
The menu, confirm, placeholder and banner pass the axe checks the existing component tests run, use only tokens (the module-css scans), and have visible focus.

Every existing frontend test passes; typecheck, lint and build pass; 0x08-frontend.md records the menu, the account states and the deactivate/recover flows (FrontendUI/components.md rows go in a Director PR: no unit role may write FrontendUI/).

Browser rows (vite preview against backend-dev, signed in with the test accounts, light and dark, 360 and 1280 wide): copy a link and paste it in a new tab; report another's post, see Reported; delete your own post from the feed and from inside the thread modal (root and reply), the card goes and Escape in the confirm leaves the modal open; deactivate from your profile, see the banner on the feed and the recovery screen on /compose; recover, and posts reappear and compose works; keyboard-only through the menu with visible focus.
